svg.title: The PR coach
svg.desc: A push to a pull request, also one from a fork, runs the checks. A check that fails explains itself in its summary and as its annotation, from the explanations of .github/checks.toml and .github/checks.project.toml. After the checks, the PR coach reads the check runs and their annotations from the API, without running any code of the pull request, and keeps one comment on the pull request up to date: a section for each check that failed, with the problem, why it matters, the fix and its commands. You push the fix, and once every check passes, the comment says so.
